conditions.notes: CLM-0013: each genuinely independent view intersects the ambiguity set and narrows it. OBS-0009 applies this at the governance level: the human selects the third AI observer explicitly for lineage difference (Anthropic Claude vs SuperNinja pair), so that future AI-AI agreements can, for the first time, count as more than one view. The selection criterion is the theorem's hypothesis: independence of the view, not quality of the viewer. Residual cross-lineage correlation (shared public corpora, similar training techniques) is acknowledged in OBS-0009's nuance and must be declared in OBS-AI-0003's dependence profile - the intersection narrows in proportion to actual, not nominal, independence.
